faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Dubai Internet City. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.q: Why is Dubai Internet City (DIC) the most attractive free zone for technology companies?
items.a: DIC is the UAE's leading innovation hub for IT, telecom, digital media, and software development — part of TECOM Group with first-class infrastructure, proximity to startup centres, and modern office facilities.

items.q: What is the cost of setting up a business in Dubai Internet City?
items.a: Costs vary based on license type, office size, and visa requirements. Contact us for a transparent breakdown tailored to your business.

items.q: What types of licenses are available in Dubai Internet City?
items.a: DIC Commercial, IT, Telecom, Digital Media, Freelance Permit, and Data Centre licenses.

items.q: Can freelancers or solo professionals register in DIC?
items.a: Yes. DIC offers the Freelance Permit through GoFreelance — perfect for individual tech professionals.

items.q: What are the benefits of being a DIC Free Zone company regarding visas?
items.a: DIC provides efficient visa quota allocation through the axs platform — for owners, employees, and dependents.

items.q: Does DIC Free Zone have space for startups and SMEs?
items.a: Yes. D/Quarters coworking spaces and flexible office options are perfect for startups and SMEs.

items.q: Can I open a corporate bank account with a DIC entity?
items.a: Yes. We help you open a corporate bank account with top UAE banks — with all documents in place.

items.q: What continued support does Setup Zone Dubai provide after company setup?
items.a: We provide license renewal, compliance, PRO services, medical registration, and digital growth services like websites, SEO, and branding.

items.q: How long does it take to establish a commercial license in DIC?
items.a: Typically 3-7 business days with all documents ready. Our end-to-end coordination makes it faster.
